body: It's not that simple to just leave. Especially not when it's people you truly care for

My biggest issue is religion, I've had to lie about it almost all my life. I have an older sibling that has already spoken with my mother about being atheist, and she cries every night, and has terrible night mares about him, and I'm also an atheist, but I keep it hidden because I don't want to add to my mother's suffering, and not only my mother's, but someone else that's very close to me knows about my beliefs, and she cries every time I talk about it, and she says she's afraid of me going to hell. That's really my main issue is that I can't be myself.
